scope: 24 complete original-source bags on unchanged full graph; offline finite intervention, not global optimum or method innovation

reference.domain: one intervention at this checkpoint; supplied finite actions; fixed continuation and future

boundary.rule: first fixed 60-second tick with public actual-empty reactive return intent; owner order sorted; no outcome search
boundary.epoch_replacement: one whole current epoch, no current-epoch demand republish; next epoch and cached publication signatures shared by every branch
